products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as providing trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company offers a portfolio of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular workflow, health data analytics, and real-world evidence. It was formerly known as Watson Health.

Among its named products, Micromedex provides clinical decision support at the point of care, while Zelta is a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for use in clinical trials. The Merge product line covers enterprise imaging and cardiovascular service lines, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo receiving a 2025 Best in KLAS ranking. Truven provides health data, analytics, and consulting services oriented toward business decision-making in healthcare settings.

The site's held facts list Merative under the Healthcare and Life Sciences AI category, noting capabilities in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are currently associated with the company in the held facts.
